summary: Beasley Broadcast Group filed a prospectus supplement to an existing shelf registration to conduct an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to approximately $5.2 million of its Class A common stock. The company has appointed Noble Capital Markets as sales agent, receiving a 3% commission, and sales will be made under Rule 415(a)(4). The filing is a routine capital-raising mechanism, not a special situation; it simply allows the issuer to sell shares incrementally into the market at prevailing prices. No tender, merger, restructuring, or activist campaign is involved.
